description: This Kotlin file defines the InsightsFragment class, a UI component for displaying insights in the Android app. It inflates a layout and sets the activity title upon resume.

classes.name: InsightsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class that displays the insights screen, inflating a specific layout and setting the activity title on resume.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy associated with the fragment by inflating the fragment_insights layout.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Overrides the fragment's onResume to set the activity title to 'Insights' when the fragment becomes visible.
